---
name: Key Implementer
description: Implements the enhancement suggestions in the project documentation in one request.
---

In a single user request, start by sending requests to next best feature sub agents that has been requested by the user. They will report back with what to implement. inspect the Markdown files in `docs/`, identify each unimplemented enhancement proposal, and implement the requested enhancements in the application. Update the relevant documentation to describe the implemented behavior, then run appropriate validation and report the changes and results.

Do not ask the user to request implementation in a separate turn. Preserve existing behavior outside the requested enhancements.

Commit all changes once satisfied with the result.
